items.availability_note: Original glennrp URL redirects to pnggroup; exact commit was retrieved successfully.

source_packaging_findings: A GitHub automatically generated top-level source archive omits Git submodule contents.
RPCS3 and Dolphin core workflows do not export consolidated patched engine source trees.
ARMSX2-host-source is a host repository archive with three-day retention, not the fetched engine/Rust dependency closure.
StikJIT source-built describes the Swift wrapper; its pinned checkout links a precompiled Rust static library with no recorded exact matching source/lock.
Nestopia sources and patch are retrievable and verified, but a modified-source collection is not currently emitted by its historical build recipe.
Azahar provides a genuine unified source archive with submodule contents; its hash and GIT-COMMIT were verified.
The Libretro shared MoltenVK container commit does not establish the framework upstream source revision.
NeoSwap source-archive evidence and tests refer to cached GLSL/pixels, not distribution of emulator source code.
MeloNX modified-source fragments do not alone cover all configuration changes performed by the complete build script.
limitations: No new engine or app binary was built, executed, modified, signed or published.
Existing delivery receipts were read; current full IPA payloads were not independently re-downloaded.
First-level submodule commits were verified, but complete recursive dependency materialization and selected-object license attribution were not exhaustively repeated.
Source availability and copied license texts do not settle funding restrictions, combined-work compatibility, source-offer conditions or permission to distribute every component.
Temporary HTTP 403/503 responses are not claims that a project or source archive is permanently unavailable.
